summary.LABEL: MODEL_FREE_CEILING
summary.WINDOW_LAW: Full PRE-MATCH life = first print/book -> the BELL (match start). Close = last print BEFORE the bell (pre-match closing line). Bell from REAL_START_LEDGER_V3: exact_start_utc (234 EXACT) else known_live_by_utc (tape-onset estimate) else schedule_bound_utc; confidence = precision_class. In-match trading-phase map stamped WRONG_PHASE_FOR_OBJECTIVE (the objective is the pre-match line).

bell_source.estimation_method: exact -> official provider match-start; else -> known_live_by (public-tape 5-prints-in-15m onset / live-v3-v4 log / tennis-db); else -> schedule bound (last resort).
